field.panel:
Document No

Document sequence number of the document

The document number is usually automatically generated by the system and determined by the document type of the document. If the document is not saved, the preliminary number is displayed in "<>". If the document type of your document has no automatic document sequence defined, the field is empty if you create a new document. This is for documents which usually have an external number (like vendor invoice). If you leave the field empty, the system will generate a document number for you. The document sequence used for this fallback number is defined in the "Maintain Sequence" window with the name "DocumentNo_", where TableName is the actual name of the table (e.g. C_Order).

ask2.q: How can I void a payment?
ask2.line: §HELP_SEARCH ask="How can I void a payment?" window=195 action=VO cli="erp.void is offered for Order (C_Order), not for Payment" howto=4 matched=["action:void","window:payment (table Payment)"]
ask2.card:
WindowPayment and Receipt
ActionVoid — Set all quantities to zero and complete transaction
Allowed when the document is: Drafted, In Progress, Invalid, Approved, Not Approved, Completed, Waiting Confirmation, Waiting Payment
CLIerp.void is offered for Order (C_Order), not for Payment
Guide4 · Receipt & Allocation

Record the customer's Payment (⌂ → Sales → Payment) against the invoice, then run Allocation to match payment to invoice. A real allocation is rarely an exact match — it can carry a discount, a write-off, and (because tax rides the discounted portion too) a VAT correction, all in the same posting.
